title: Campus picker for Lakeside College onboarding
text:
The signup flow assumes Westbrook University. For the Lakeside College launch in January we need:

* A campus step in onboarding (or inferred from the student's email domain)
* Campus-specific course catalogs (reuse the Westbrook importer)
* Campus-scoped matching so students are only matched within their own campus

Crestview State follows in March, so keep campuses data-driven rather than hard-coded. Maya will confirm the Lakeside launch date and ambassador.
